references.text: Background to this verse: The daughters of Zelophehad were granted inheritance rights, raising the question of what happens to the inheritance if they marry outside their tribe.
The solution to the problem presented in this verse: The inheritance must not pass from one tribe to another; each Israelite shall hold fast to the inheritance of his ancestral tribe.
Provisions of the Jubilee year requiring property to return to the original family, which is relevant to concerns about inheritance transfer between tribes.
The fulfillment of the daughters of Zelophehad's inheritance rights when the land was distributed in the time of Joshua.
Instructions on how the land was to be distributed by casting lots among the tribes, which forms the background for the concern expressed in this verse.
